title: Lever Balance Simulator
description: SVG lever with a fulcrum, two weights, live torque bars and a bubble level. The student adjusts weights (and distances) until clockwise and counter-clockwise torque match.

parameters_schema.default_distance_A: number (m) left arm at start, <= max_distance
parameters_schema.default_distance_B: number (m) right arm at start, <= max_distance
parameters_schema.max_distance: number (m) slider maximum for both arms
parameters_schema.fulcrum_offset: number -0.5..0.5, shifts the fulcrum along the beam (0 = centered)
parameters_schema.target_balance: boolean; true = student must balance, false = free exploration with Continue
parameters_schema.allow_distance: boolean; expose distance sliders (false = weights only)
parameters_schema.hint: string shown when the student asks for a hint

defaults.instruction: Adjust the weights or their distances until the lever balances.
defaults.hint: Torque = weight × distance. The heavier side needs a shorter arm.

success_hint: |weight_A × distance_A − weight_B × distance_B| ≤ tolerance (or Continue when target_balance is false)
